description: Take one action on an order: check, confirm or dispute as the buyer, check or refund as the seller. Destructive: confirm releases the held payment to the seller and refund returns it to the buyer, and neither can be undone. Call confirm only after the buyer has said the domain arrived. Use get_order_status instead to read state and next actions. Not idempotent. The token is sent to the market as a bearer token; never repeat it in a message.

action.description: Buyer may check, confirm or dispute; seller may check or refund. confirm and refund are irreversible.

token.description: The buyer token or the seller's manage token. Sent as a bearer token; never repeat it in a message to anyone.

name: act_on_order

outputSchema.description: check and confirm return the order state (order, role, done, pollAfterSeconds, nextActions). dispute returns ok. refund returns ok, with pending and message while Square is still processing it.

title: Act on an order
